entries.57c4d4a506806c7c: Its strengths are the unique metal technologies accumulated since its founding in 1939, and the development capabilities and production technology in chemical manufacturing based on them. It handles inorganic and organometallic chemicals across a wide range of types and applications, including surface treatment chemicals, catalyst chemicals, chemicals for battery and electronic components, and chemicals for ceramics and glass, and it is also advancing the development of unique technologies, such as PFAS-free composite plating, which the company developed ahead of the world. Overseas, the Thai subsidiary manufactures plating solutions and automotive-related products, and is responsible for expanding into overseas markets.
entries.70d6290d60152154: It manufactures industrial chemicals, including metal compounds such as copper, tin and nickel compounds and surface treatment chemicals, as well as residential building materials, and sells them from its bases in Japan and Thailand.

entries.7cea53dd3466e4db: Under the medium-term management plan launched in October 2023, the company has set the basic policy 'Polish unique metal technologies and keep creating new value, and take on the challenge of realizing a sustainable society together with diverse partners', and it is working on two basic strategies: 'strengthening the business foundation and expanding growth areas' and 'solving social issues'. To strengthen the business foundation, the company cites accelerating the development of high-performance products together with customers, creating new businesses using its strength in recycling technology, strengthening overseas market expansion centered on the Thai subsidiary (Siam NKS), promoting strategic partnerships, and active investment to support its growth strategy.

entries.c580b89da4655542: A business manufacturing and selling industrial chemicals. It manufactures and sells metal compounds such as copper, tin, nickel and cobalt, metal soaps such as octylic acid, battery chemicals, surface-treatment brighteners and additives, and electroless nickel plating solutions, and carries out contract processing of cathode materials for secondary batteries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥24,136 million. The company manufactures and sells the products, and the consolidated subsidiary Siam NKS CO.,LTD. manufactures and sells industrial chemicals in Thailand.

entries.dacc8df00c84033b: The company and 2 subsidiaries form a group, and its head office is located in Taito-ku, Tokyo. As of March 31, 2026, the number of consolidated employees was 454.

It manufactures and sells residential building materials such as fire-prevention ventilation edge trims, simple eaves, mailboxes and handrails and copings, and building materials such as the heat exchanger 'Cool Fin'. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,895 million. The company manufactures and sells the products.
